plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, says Chris Mellon, a man active in pushing the US government to reveal what it knows about UFOs, told him he wanted to question a recent head of science and technology at the CIA, the US foreign spy agency. Mellon's point, as Michels tells it, was that they needed to find out what she knows about UFOs.
